verdict.rationale: vLLM installs as a Python package via pip/uv and documents an offline-inference mode configured with Python-style arguments such as `trust_remote_code=True`, which points to an in-process Python API. Its OpenAI-compatible server (plus Anthropic Messages and gRPC) means existing OpenAI-style clients can call it, but the pack shows no dedicated vLLM client SDK. missing for 10: documented official vLLM client libraries (especially JavaScript), explicit Python client/API reference docs, independent corroboration of client-library usage.
